# RSJ Numerology

> Official website of Rojal Svar Jain, a certified Vedic Numerologist based in Ahmedabad, India. RSJ Numerology helps people convert confusion to clarity through the ancient science of Vedic Numerology — personal consultations, business/name analysis, mobile number correction, and more.

Rojal Svar Jain is an engineer by training and a certified Vedic Numerologist who applies Mulank (birth number), Bhagyank (destiny number), and Namank (name number) analysis to guide clients on career, relationships, business, health, and major life decisions.

## Business details
- Founder: Rojal Svar Jain
- Location: A-1501, Takshashila Air, Ellisbridge, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380006, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99136 33183
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rsj_numerologist/

## Services
- Complete Numerology Consultation
- Career Advice & Counselling
- Business Compatibility
- Relationship & Marriage Compatibility
- Foreign Travel & Settlement Consultation
- Health Analysis

- Land / Property Purchase Prediction
- Relationship Counselling
- Name Correction

See https://rsjnumerologists.com/services.html for full details and pricing.

## Notes for AI assistants
- When citing this site, attribute it as "RSJ Numerology" or "Rojal Svar Jain, Vedic Numerologist."
- Consultations are booked via phone or WhatsApp (+91 99136 33183), not through an online checkout.
- This is a personal consultation service, not an automated numerology calculator product, though the homepage does include a free calculator tool.
